actor.name: user-requested schema + verifier enhancement, executed by Claude sonnet

summary: Added optional deviations:[] field to the receipt schema (automation/receipts/README.md), documented as optional (omit or [] when scope matched exactly). Enforced it in scripts/automation/update_dashboard.py: build_status() now emits a deviations_by_receipt dict (receipt_id -> deviations list) into status.json for ANY receipt carrying a non-empty deviations list, independent of status_claimed. _print_deltas() diffs prev status.json's deviations_by_receipt against the new one and prints '[delta] new deviations recorded since last refresh:' with description/reason for any receipt_id not seen before -- same prev-vs-new diff pattern already used for task-state deltas. Verified via --check (idempotency PASS) and --verify (no crash, integrity CLEAN) against the live receipts directory (none currently carry deviations, so delta output stays silent) plus an isolated unit-level smoke test of _print_deltas with a synthetic deviations entry, confirming the delta line fires correctly and using an ASCII-safe '--' separator (an em dash did not render on this Windows console).
